info.title: NGO Volunteer and Donation Management System
info.description:
REST API for the **NGO Volunteer and Donation Management System** (SRS Release 1.0).

* Auth: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` -> use the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
* All `/api/v1/admin/**` routes need an Admin token.
* Money values in responses are **strings with two decimals** (e.g. `"1500.00"`).
* Errors always look like `{ "detail": "...", "code": "...", "errors": [{"field","message"}] }`.

simulate_outcome.title: Simulate Outcome

DonationConfirmationSummary.title: DonationConfirmationSummary

donor.description: Required for guests. Ignored when logged in as a Donor (profile is used instead).

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Secret for this donation. Send as the X-Donation-Token header (or ?token=) on confirm/cancel/retry/receipt calls. Required for guests; logged-in donors may use their JWT instead.

DonorDetail.title: DonorDetail
DonorDetail.description: Donor.Record.View: every campaign contributed to, with amounts and dates.

DonorSummary.title: DonorSummary

DuplicateGroup.description: Donor.Merge.Flag: several donor records sharing one e-mail address.

event_date.title: Event Date
event_date.description: ISO 8601. Naive values are read as Asia/Kolkata time.

GuestDonorDetails.title: GuestDonorDetails
